A. Leaf Arrangement & Architecture
    1. Leaf relative position (alternate / opposite / whorled): alternate (leaves are attached at successive nodes along the stem, alternating sides; no paired or whorled arrangement visible)
    2. Leaf spacing (clustered / distal): clustered (leaves appear grouped near the apex, with short internodes, giving a clustered appearance)
B. Leaf Complexity
    3. Leaf complexity (simple / compound): simple (each leaf blade is undivided, no leaflets present)

    5. Number of leaflets (integer estimate 2, 4, 8, …): N/A

    8. Leaf shape (elliptic, obovate, lanceolate, etc.): lanceolate (longer than wide, tapering to a point at the apex, broadest near the base)
